findings.why: The drawing in force is Rev C, which requires EN AW-6082-T6 and yield of at least 250 MPa. Elena's mail quotes the superseded Rev B values (6061-T6, 240 MPa). The offered 6061-T6 bar does not meet the Rev C grade, and its 240 MPa minimum is below the 250 MPa requirement.
